DLC2317:3:t_3:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$アルト$$'s one thing, but I never knew $$宗介$$ could act that well. You'd better watch out too, $$かなめ$$.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm not worried. $$宗介$$ and $$アルト$$ aren't like that.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$ and $$アルト$$ argue like that all the time in the $$ボランティア部$$.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I've seen them go from practically at each other's throats to laughing together a minute later plenty of times.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:12.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「So that's all it was back then, too!?」

DLC2317:3:t_3:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「There is nothing to be surprised about.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「We were just being our usual selves.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:17.en:
$$カレン$$
（$$アルト$$... $$宗介$$ has settled his love triangle properly.）

DLC2317:3:t_3:18.en:
$$ミシェル$$
（You'd better step up too.）

DLC2317:3:t_3:19.en:
$$アルト$$
（I know that without you telling me!）

DLC2317:3:t_3:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you all whispering about?」

DLC2317:3:t_3:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「Ignore them, $$千鳥$$. Ultimately, $$アルト$$ is a man who will always eat my dust.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「Surviving a miracle's really given you a big mouth!」

DLC2317:3:t_3:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「Does that bother you? I am surprised that someone as timid as you has that much fighting spirit.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then prove you can do it too. Even with everyone watching, I kissed $$千鳥$$ and...」

DLC2317:3:t_3:27.en:
$$ルカ$$
「...If $$千鳥$$ had been there that day, she'd probably have jumped in like that before things got so nasty.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:28.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's our $$ボランティア部$$ manager. She really keeps things running smoothly.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:29.en:
$$クラン$$
「$$かなめ$$ is now officially part of $c's support team, too. We will be counting on you.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So babysitting $$宗介$$ is officially my job now...」

DLC2317:3:t_3:32.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's not what I meant, but...」

DLC2317:3:t_3:33.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You're really going for it, $$宗介$$.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「After coming back from a $$時空震動$$, I have nothing to fear.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「I give up. I'll take a page from your book.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:37.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll do it when the time comes.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「Understood, $$アルト$$. I look forward to seeing you fight that battle.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Red and white colors, a machine named for a magic sword that turns feelings into power... $$宗介$$ and $$アルト$$ have a surprising amount in common.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come to think of it, those two have been squabbling all the time since the $$時獄戦役$$.」

DLC2317:3:t_3:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ミスリル$$ is a military force, and so is $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ So go ahead and fight, but play nicely...」

DLC2317:3:t_3:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2317:4:t_000:2.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「We, the $$暁の疾風旅団$$, will now begin our operation.」

DLC2317:4:t_000:3.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「We need supplies and money to blow the Empire to hell! We're going to get them from the town!」

DLC2317:4:t_000:4.en:
$$傭兵$$
（In other words, we're stealing them.）

DLC2317:4:t_000:5.en:
$$傭兵$$
（Well... With the world the way it is, this is the only life we've got.）

DLC2317:4:t_000:6.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「All units, move out! Any citizens who refuse to cooperate can suffer a little pain!」

DLC2317:4:t_001:0.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Just like $$ルカ$$ reported. They've got a decent number of units.」

DLC2317:4:t_001:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「They've even got Imperial machines. These guys sure know how to make do.」

DLC2317:4:t_001:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Just some passing champions of justice.」

DLC2317:4:t_001:4.en:
$$クラン$$
「In the name of heaven, we shall punish you!」

DLC2317:4:t_001:6.en:
$$傭兵$$
「This'll get us warmed up before we head out! We'll turn the tables on you!」

DLC2317:4:t_001:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「That makes it easier for us to take out our frustrations on you.」

DLC2317:4:t_001:9.en:
$$マオ$$
「All right, $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$! Whoever shoots down more enemies wins!」

DLC2317:4:t_001:11.en:
$$クラン$$
「Prepare yourselves, $$ミスリル$$! We will show you our strength!」

DLC2317:4:t_001:14.en:
$$マオ$$
「Let's do this, $$ウルズ$$ 6, $$ウルズ$$ 7! Rock and roll!!」

DLC2317:4:t_002:2.en:
$$クラン$$
「Did you see that, Second Lieutenant $$マオ$$? Let us hear you sing the praises of the victorious $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$!」

DLC2317:4:t_002:4.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「A team victory counts as an individual victory, so I guess that makes me $c's number one sniper, too?」

DLC2317:4:t_002:5.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Oh... $$ヨーコ$$ isn't here, so let's make that the number one handsome sniper.」

DLC2317:4:t_002:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You bastard! Don't think you can slip that one past me in the confusion!」

DLC2317:4:t_003:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「All right! Victory for $$ミスリル$$!」

DLC2317:4:t_003:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「Admit it, Captain $$クラン$$. It's what they call justice prevailing.」

DLC2317:4:t_003:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「How about that, $$ミシェル$$!? A sniper's job is to lead their allies to victory! That settles our contest too!」

DLC2317:4:t_003:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「From today on, I'll proudly call myself $c's number one handsome sniper!」

DLC2317:4:t_003:6.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Hold on a second! I can't agree with the handsome part!」

review.context: The briefing-room framing scene reveals the quarrel was normal banter; battle events include alternative victory outcomes in the Mithril versus S.M.S. contest.
decisions: Preserved separate alternative battle-result branches without making them one timeline.
Whispered parenthetical exchanges retain source thought-style punctuation.
Dawn Gale Brigade is a provisional rendering of an unlisted group name.
uncertainties: Dawn Gale Brigade needs glossary confirmation.
